newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-GIANTS PITCHER FERNANDEZ HAS SEASON-ENDING SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-GIANTS PITCHER FERNANDEZ HAS SEASON-ENDING SURGERY.

text.p: San Francisco Giants pitcher Osvaldo Fernandez had season-ending surgery on his right elbow Tuesday to remove loose bodies and repair damage to the medial tendon, the team announced Wednesday.
The 28-year-old Cuban-born right-hander, who was placed on the 15-day disabled list from June 26 with inflammation in his right elbow, also was on the list this season from May 20-June 19.
Fernandez is 3-4 with a 4.95 earned run average in 11 starts this season. He was 0-3 in his last six outings, last winning on April 27 at Houston.
